_schema.generated: ISO timestamp of the daily refresh; the page shows it and flags >=2d stale
_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> array of news items, any order (the page sorts newest-first and filters to the last 7 days)

item.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the news broke (the page joins this to own price data for the 1d move)
item.headline: one line, what happened
item.why: optional, one line on why it matters for this name
item.src: publication or filing the item came from - required for anything asserted as fact

META.headline: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable AI models to date
META.why: First frontier-class model release positions Meta to compete directly with OpenAI and Anthropic, with flagship model gated behind a new paid Muse Code subscription

META.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald cuts Meta price target to $840 from $860
META.why: Trim from a bullish shop on the same day as the Muse Wonder launch shows mixed near-term sentiment heading into Q3 earnings

META.headline: Meta bars ByteDance/TikTok from buying ads on Facebook and Instagram in seven countries
META.why: Escalates the Meta-TikTok rivalry over users and ad dollars, cutting off a competitor's access to Meta's ad inventory in key markets including the US

META.headline: Wells Fargo raises Meta price target to $1,000 from $796, keeps Overweight
META.why: Sizable bullish target hike signals growing Street conviction on Meta's AI-driven growth ahead of Q3 earnings
META.src: Wells Fargo research note (via Defense World/Benzinga)

NVDA.headline: Nvidia opens Vera Rubin rack designs to Open Compute Project, unveils pluggable optics with Cisco
NVDA.why: Pushes Nvidia's next-gen AI-factory architecture toward an open industry standard, reinforcing its ecosystem lock-in ahead of Rubin ramp

NVDA.headline: Nvidia in talks to acquire or raise its stake in AI startup Reflection AI, FT reports
NVDA.why: M&A optionality in open-weight AI models could extend Nvidia's software/model reach beyond chips

NVDA.headline: Nvidia-backed Firmus withdraws $5.5B Australian IPO citing weak investor demand
NVDA.why: Signals investor pushback on AI data-center valuations within Nvidia's own backed-company ecosystem

NVDA.headline: Nvidia and Microsoft launch RTX Spark hardware and AI-agent software for Windows PCs
NVDA.why: Extends Nvidia's AI stack into consumer PCs, a new demand channel alongside data-center GPUs

AAPL.headline: Apple unveils first touchscreen MacBook Pro (OLED) and new iMac with M6 chip
AAPL.why: Opens a new premium-priced Mac upgrade cycle, with 14"/16" MacBook Pro starting at $2,899

AAPL.headline: Evercore ISI reiterates Outperform, raises AAPL target to $380 after new Mac launch
AAPL.why: Sell-side target hike signals confidence in Mac refresh ahead of Nov 2 fiscal Q4 earnings

AAPL.headline: Counterpoint: iPhone 18 Pro global sales growth slows to 3.1% three weeks post-launch
AAPL.why: US sales down 4% offset by China growth, a demand signal ahead of Apple's Nov 2 earnings report

AAPL.headline: iPhone Duo resale premiums in China collapse days after launch, some orders canceled
AAPL.why: Fading scalper demand suggests cooling enthusiasm for Apple's first foldable in a key growth market

MSFT.headline: Microsoft prices $25B senior notes offering to help fund AI infrastructure buildout
MSFT.why: New debt load tied to a reported ~$170B 2026 capex target signals sustained heavy AI spending ahead

MSFT.headline: Microsoft Q1 FY2027 revenue $92.3B beats estimates; Azure growth accelerates to 48% YoY
MSFT.why: Cloud reacceleration (Microsoft Cloud revenue $63.9B, +30% YoY) is the core AI-demand thesis for MSFT, though capex hit $45.2B and free cash flow fell 27% YoY

MSFT.headline: Microsoft says OpenAI generated ~$10B of revenue, about 11% of total quarterly revenue
MSFT.why: Shows growing customer-concentration exposure to OpenAI; OpenAI still owes Microsoft over $7B in unpaid bills

MSFT.headline: Bernstein raises Microsoft price target to $722 from $662, keeps Outperform
MSFT.why: Sell-side reaction ahead of earnings reflects rising expectations for Azure/AI growth

GOOGL.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, a mid-tier Gemini 4 model, via API, Gemini app and Antigravity
GOOGL.why: Google positions Neon between Carbon and Hydrogen on depth versus efficiency. Google's published benchmarks show it ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol on most tests, and API pricing is reported at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.

GOOGL.headline: Alphabet-owned Isomorphic Labs announces $5B Series C led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, with GV and CapitalG participating
GOOGL.why: Large outside funding round for an Alphabet-owned AI drug-discovery unit, six months after its $2.1B May round. Sources say no valuation was disclosed.

AMZN.headline: Amazon agrees to buy Decart's AI chip optimization tech and hire its founders; Bloomberg reports $7.5B
AMZN.why: Targets Trainium performance as AWS prepares to sell the chips (TechCrunch); Amazon disclosed no price and the $7.5B comes from Bloomberg's source.

AMZN.headline: Oppenheimer raises AMZN target to $310 from $285, Outperform, on value of Anthropic stake after IPO
AMZN.why: Helfstein estimates about 3.5B Anthropic shares, worth roughly $339B at $97 before a 15% holding-company discount. One outlet dates the note to Wednesday, so the exact day is uncertain, but all sources place it inside the window.

AMZN.headline: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq (ANT): IPO priced at $83, opened at $111.50; Amazon holds about 14.6-14.7% after the offering
AMZN.why: Gives Amazon's Anthropic stake a public mark. Sources differ slightly on the exact percentage and on how long the opening pop held (one report had about $94.60 by early afternoon).

AMD.headline: HGS selects Rackspace Technology for private AI infrastructure powered by AMD
AMD.why: First named customer deployment under Rackspace's multiyear AMD compute agreement, evidence of deal pipeline converting to deployments

AMD.headline: Susquehanna raises AMD price target to $650 from $620, reiterates positive rating
AMD.why: Sell-side target hike reflects rising conviction in AMD's AI/data-center trajectory ahead of Q3 earnings

AMD.headline: AMD to invest $1B in Meta's equity offering as Helios rack systems begin running at Meta
AMD.why: Deepens AMD's compute relationship with a top hyperscaler and gives AMD a financial stake in Meta's AI buildout

AMD.headline: AMD expands Oracle deal: 6th Gen EPYC CPUs and Pensando DPUs to power new OCI Compute E7 instances
AMD.why: Broadens AMD's data-center silicon footprint inside Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, both CPU and networking

AVGO.headline: D.A. Davidson upgrades Broadcom to Buy, raises price target to $400 from $350
AVGO.why: Analyst Gil Luria cites Anthropic's S-1 filing as evidence AI capex cycle and Broadcom's custom-chip demand will hold up

AVGO.headline: William Blair downgrades Broadcom to Market Perform from Outperform
AVGO.why: Cites valuation above 40x earnings and risk from Broadcom's concentrated AI customer base plus its Anthropic financing backstop exposure

AVGO.headline: Broadcom arranges $63B financing deal with banks to fund Anthropic's chip purchases
AVGO.why: Locks in long-term custom AI chip demand from Anthropic but adds backstop/residual-value exposure to Broadcom's balance sheet

INTC.headline: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan says Intel has signed its first outside customer for 18A, unnamed
INTC.why: External 18A demand is the foundry thesis analysts cited as unproven. Intel's CTO later said on X that the customer is on 18A-P. Sources differ on whether this is truly the first 18A customer.

INTC.headline: Microsoft and Intel expand Azure deal: multi-year Xeon supply incl. Diamond Rapids, and Intel Foundry EMIB packaging
INTC.why: Microsoft is the first to publicly commit to EMIB packaging for its own Azure chips, a foundry packaging win. Financial terms, duration and volumes were not disclosed.

TSM.headline: TSMC Q3 revenue hits record NT$1.49tn (~$46.7B), up ~50% YoY, above top of guidance
TSM.why: Confirms demand strength ahead of Oct 15 earnings; beat implies upside to consensus estimates

TSM.headline: TSMC signs $2B deal for GlobalFoundries to make CoWoS silicon interposers in US from 2028
TSM.why: Adds a second, US-based interposer source to ease TSMC's sold-out CoWoS packaging bottleneck

TSM.headline: Barclays raises TSMC price target to $665 from $650, keeps Overweight/Buy
TSM.why: Analyst Simon Coles cites improved industry fundamentals ahead of Q3 results despite recent chip-sector selloff

ASML.headline: Samsung and SK Hynix accept ASML's 10% price hike on EUV/DUV replacement parts, effective Jan 2027
ASML.why: Rare across-the-board pricing power move boosts near-term Installed Base revenue outlook

ASML.headline: ASML CEO Fouquet says AI chip demand boom could extend beyond 2028; Broadcom's Tan flags financing as bottleneck
ASML.why: Extends visibility on demand duration but introduces financing/capital constraint as a new risk to the upgrade cycle

ASML.headline: ASML and Zeiss publish peer-reviewed paper on 'Hyper NA' EUV successor, ~10 years out
ASML.why: Signals next lithography generation beyond High NA is technically feasible, extending ASML's long-term moat narrative

ASML.headline: BofA and Barclays raise ASML price targets to €2,557 and €2,450 on higher ASPs/volumes
ASML.why: Sell-side lifts EUV/DUV pricing and unit forecasts ahead of Q3 print, reinforcing AI-driven demand thesis

MRVL.headline: Lumentum CEO defends $115B all-stock Marvell deal after stock plunge: 'We've got work to do' with shareholders
MRVL.why: Deal needs approval from both companies' stockholders and is expected to close in 1H 2028, so the target's CEO is publicly saying shareholders still have to be won over.

9988.headline: Alibaba Sept-qtr revenue RMB271.5bn (+10%); AI Cloud & Compute revenue +53% to RMB60.97bn, external customers +64%
9988.why: Cloud growth is the core of the AI thesis; the release also gives non-GAAP net income of RMB19.9bn (+92%). One outlet reports adjusted EPS missed some estimates, and another reports free cash flow of -RMB34.5bn.

9988.headline: Management reportedly sees next-year cloud growth of 30-45%, down from 53%, and reaffirmed 2030 targets
9988.why: A slower cloud growth range would sit below the current run-rate. The 2030 targets are US$100bn external cloud revenue and 20%+ EBITDA margin. This comes from earnings-call reporting, not the filing.

0700.headline: Morgan Stanley cuts Tencent price target to HK$650 from HK$735, keeps Overweight
0700.why: Cites AI investment pressure cutting 2026-27 non-IFRS operating profit estimates by 6-7%, a read on near-term margin risk

0700.headline: Tencent launches ~$5B bond offering (USD and offshore yuan notes) mainly to fund AI capex
0700.why: Shows Tencent financing its AI buildout via debt rather than only cash flow, raising leverage to support capex

0700.headline: AI agent startup Manus raises $500M+ at ~$4B valuation with Tencent among investors
0700.why: Extends Tencent's strategic AI investment footprint following the collapse of Manus's Meta acquisition

0700.headline: DeepSeek nears $12B pre-IPO funding round backed by Tencent and CATL ahead of 2027 Shanghai listing
0700.why: Signals Tencent deepening its stake in a leading rival/partner AI model maker, adding to its AI investment portfolio exposure

3690.headline: Meituan announces board meeting on Nov 27 to approve Q3 2026 results, with a call that evening HK time
3690.why: Sets the date for the next hard data on food-delivery losses and the Q3 unit-economics guidance, ahead of the Nov 27 release.

9618.headline: JD.com's Double 11 mid-event report: AI hardware GMV up over 130% versus prior period
9618.why: Signals strong Q4 demand momentum in JD's AI-hardware category, a read-through for holiday-quarter revenue ahead of the Nov 12 Q3 print
